INSERT INTO SJT0BK ( CORP_GR, TR_YMD, TR_CD, BALH_CO, BAED_MTH, BAEJ_MTH, ILBAN_AEK, WOOS_AEK, CASH_ILBAN_RT, CASH_WOOS_RT, STOCK_ILBAN_RT, STOCK_WOOS_RT, BROK_YMD, BAED_GISAN_YMD, JUCHONG_YMD ) VALUES ( #{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), #{trCd}, #{balhCo}, #{baedMth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{baejMth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ilbanAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{woosAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cashIlbanRt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cashWoosRt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{stockIlbanRt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{stockWoosRt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{brokYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'),
TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{baedGisanYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') NULL ,
TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{juchongYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') NULL
)
